newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan ministry to cut medical spending - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan ministry to cut medical spending - paper.

text.p: The Ministry of Health and Welfare is planning to cap the Japanese government's medical spending by imposing a ceiling on its coverage of drug costs, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said on Thursday.
Under the plan, insurance payments for chronic diseases such as diabetes will also be fixed and old people will have to pay more of their medical expenses, the paper said.
The ruling Liberal Democratic Party plans to finalise the ministry's plan by the end of August, the paper said.
The ministry has formed the plan to curb rapid growth in national medical expenditure, the paper said, adding that pharmaceutical companies and doctors may strongly oppose the planned reforms.
The ministry was not immediately available for comment on the report.
